entry_state: Performance awards require the applicable schedule, return observations, employment conditions and delivery terms. Later forms change surviving rights without proving an earlier grant was amended. Debt schedules distinguish contractual payment from carrying value; modification, default and compound settlement retain separate rules. The early-repurchase valuation has begun and continues with its precision and inducement cases.
exit_state: Conversion inducements use the binding amendment and legal release dates; delivery can be a later transfer within equity. Cash-flow hedge reserves track cumulative effectiveness and leave equity according to the hedged transaction, independently of derivative settlement. Fair-value adjustments change subsequent effective interest. Excluded option time value needs separate actual and aligned valuations, transaction or period treatment, and cumulative measurement. The mismatched-strike example has introduced its two intrinsic values and conditional reserve formulas; its final transaction remains to be read.
findings: The amendment example separates offer, binding release and delivery, and distinguishes a share settlement from a cash bonus payable without recognising a second loss.
The cumulative hedge example reconstructs period OCI of four and loss of one from derivative gain three; basis adjustment is distinct from recycling and from settlement cash.

The option premium example reconciles inventory cost 106, profit 24 and final cash 224. The period-protection and mismatched-time-value examples keep amortisation and cumulative remeasurement separate.
The page 206 actual and hypothetical call values use different strikes. Reading has reached the formulas but not the completion of that transaction. No additional confirmed defect in this segment.
